chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from 'Amr ibn Shimir, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
They do not kill the prophets or the descendants of the prophets except the sons of fornication.
ai.seo_question: Who kills the prophets according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) to identify the specific lineage of the killers of the prophets, linking it to the killer of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) and Yahya ibn Zakariyya (a.s.). The term 'sons of fornication' (awlād zinā) is interpreted by Shia scholars not merely as illegitimate birth, but as a spiritual characteristic of those whose lineage is marked by deviation and enmity towards the Ahl al-Bayt. This narration underscores the continuity of prophetic martyrdom and identifies the killers as a distinct group within the broader community of disbelievers.
